data.description: This golden ring, set with seven brightly colored gems, functions as a ring of protection +1. In addition, seven times per day, the wearer can use Beast Shape IV to transform into a songbird for 10 minutes (use statistics for a raven).
data.name: Ring Of Seven Lovely Colors

raw_tokens.value: Ring Of Seven Lovely Colors|TIMES=1|CASTERLEVEL=7|Beast Shape IV (Ring Of Seven Lovely Colors)

This golden ring, set with seven brightly colored gems, functions as a ring of protection +1. In addition, seven times per day, the wearer can use Beast Shape IV to transform into a songbird for 10 minutes (use statistics for a raven).
